AN328
Anthropology and Visual Culture
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
explores the use of audio-visual recording techniques in ethnographic fieldwork, the documentary representation of social groups and social action in still photographs and ethnographic film, and the study of representations of cultural difference in mass media imagery.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
